sentences.text: Case was heard on 23.11.2022,

Court has passed the following order:-
"Heard Sri Ajay Sengar, learned counsel for the applicants, Ms. Ruchita Singh,
learned counsel for respondent no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.
By way of the instant application, the applicants have sought to quash the entire proceeding of complaint case no.0019 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and u/s 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Ekdil, District Etawah, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, court no.02, Etawah Jalaun on the basis of the compromise.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, court no.02, Etawah Jalaun
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the applicants and learned counsel for respondent no.2 submit that both the parties filed compromise deed dated 30.10.2022 (Annexure No.5) to the affidavit filed in support of this application as understanding has reached between the parties to settle their dispute amicably.
The claim so raised is sustained.
The present compromise deed is required to be verified physically by the trial court.
In view of above, it is directed that both the parties shall appear on 02.12.2022 before the court concerned and shall present the compromise deed before it.

In the event on 02.12.2022, verification process cannot be drawn and is incomplete because of unforeseen circumstances / paucity of time of the court, then the date of next working will be fixed for its verification.
In case, any compromise deed is so presented then physical verification of the parties shall be done and the order shall be passed by the court concerned thereon.
In case any order is passed by the court concerned, the certified copy of the same shall be placed on record by way of filing affidavit by the present applicants.
List this case on 12.12.2022 in the additional cause list.

Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case."
4.

Pursuant to the order of this Court dated 23.11.2022, learned Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 2,
Etawah has verified the compromise between the parties on 2.12.2022 and information to this effect has been received before this Court on 9.12.2022.
5.

Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the present matter is arising out of matrimonial dispute and now the parties have entered into compromise, therefore, present proceeding may be quashed.

6. Sri Akshay Raj Singh, advocate holding brief of Ms. Richita Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has not objected the aforesaid fact and submitted that in case proceedings is quashed, he would have no objection.

8. Thus in view of the well settled principle of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the matters of Krishnappa & Ors. vs. State of Karnataka; 2021 0 Supreme(SC) 529, Parbatbhai Aahir @
Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and Ors. vs. State of Gujarat and another; 2017 9 SCC 641, B.S.
Joshi Vs. State of Haryana; 2003(4) SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Burea of Investigation and another; (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 677, Gian Singh Vs. Stated of Punjab; (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & others Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2014) Supreme Today 642, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
